text: Healthy living means taking care of your body and mind. First, eat a balanced diet with plenty of fruit, vegetables, and water, and avoid too much sugar or fast food. Second, exercise regularly—even a short walk every day helps. Third, make sure you get enough sleep, because your body needs rest to stay strong. Don't forget mental health: talk to friends and family when you feel stressed. Finally, try to keep a good work-life balance. Spend time on your job or studies, but also relax and enjoy your hobbies. Small daily habits can make a big difference to how you feel.
